blocks.t: The district magistrate and the police
blocks.x: Executive magistracy supervises; the police investigate — a colonial division that survives.
blocks.th: **Police Act, 1861**, enacted after 1857 to make the police an instrument of control.
blocks.in: DM's powers under the BNSS (preventive sections), and coordination with the SP; the DM chairs the DDMA.
blocks.gl: Prefectoral control of police in France.
blocks.w: The DM-SP relationship is the classic **coordination-without-command** problem.

blocks.x: Diagnosed for fifty years, implemented in fragments.
blocks.th: **National Police Commission (1977-81)**, eight reports; **Ribeiro (1998)**, **Padmanabhaiah (2000)**, **Malimath (2003)**; **Soli Sorabjee's Model Police Act (2006)**.
blocks.in: **Prakash Singh (2006)** — State Security Commission, two-year tenure for DGP and field officers, **separation of investigation from law and order**, Police Establishment Board, Police Complaints Authority.
blocks.gl: Independent police complaints commissions in the UK.
blocks.w: Compliance is **partial in most states** — the model case of judicial direction without executive follow-through.

blocks.in: Police-population ratio ~**155 per lakh** against the UN norm of 222; vacancy ~20-22%; women ~12% against a declared 33%; most time spent on VIP security and law and order rather than investigation.
blocks.gl: Community policing ratios in OECD states.
blocks.w: Separating **investigation from law and order** is the reform that would free capacity.

blocks.x: Three new codes replaced the colonial trio from **1 July 2024**.
blocks.th: **Malimath (2003)** on a partly inquisitorial shift and victim rights.
blocks.in: **BNS, BNSS, BSA** — community service, Zero FIR and e-FIR, timelines for charge-sheet and judgment, mandatory forensics for offences of 7+ years, sedition recast as **Section 152**.
blocks.w: New codes change procedure; **capacity determines whether anything changes**.

blocks.x: Policing by consent produces better information than policing by force.
blocks.in: **Janamaithri Suraksha (Kerala)**; Tamil Nadu's all-women stations (first, 1992); Bhiwandi's **mohalla committees** pre-empting riots.
blocks.w: A mohalla committee is worth more than a **post-riot commission**.

blocks.x: A layered structure of intelligence, investigation and armed reserve.
blocks.in: **NIA (2008)** with extraterritorial jurisdiction after 2019; **NATGRID**; **MAC**; **I4C** with 22+ lakh cyber complaints a year; **CAPFs ~10 lakh**; NSG; CCTNS and ICJS.
blocks.w: Coordination, not creation, is the persistent gap — **I4C exists because no single agency can act in the first hour**.

blocks.th: **DM Act, 2005**; **Sendai Framework 2015-30** with its four priorities.
blocks.in: NDMA (PM), SDMA (CM), **DDMA (Collector)**, NDRF's 16 battalions, NIDM; **DM (Amendment) Act, 2025** giving statutory status to the NCMC and providing an **Urban Disaster Management Authority**; NDMF/SDMF mitigation funds.
blocks.w: Odisha's **zero-casualty evacuations** show the shift is measurable in lives.

blocks.x: Force must be lawful, proportionate and accountable.
blocks.th: **Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993**; **D.K. Basu (1997)** arrest safeguards; **Nilabati Behera (1993)** public-law compensation.
blocks.in: NHRC's limits — recommendatory powers, the **one-year bar**, and only a **report** from the armed forces; custodial deaths and encounter guidelines.
blocks.gl: **Paris Principles** as the benchmark for national institutions.
blocks.w: NHRC's three limits are the standard critique — name them.
